cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project("NVIDIA")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MESSAGE_INDENT "[${PROJECT_NAME}] ")

#- NVIDIA Maxine SDK
if(NOT TARGET NVIDIA::Maxine)
    add_library(NVIDIA::Maxine IMPORTED INTERFACE)
    target_include_directories(NVIDIA::Maxine
        INTERFACE
            "${StreamFX_SOURCE_DIR}/third-party/nvidia-maxine-sdk/"
    )
endif()

streamfx_component_register(${PROJECT_NAME})
target_link_libraries(${COMPONENT_TARGET}
    PRIVATE
        NVIDIA::Maxine
)

if(NOT D_PLATFORM_WINDOWS)
    streamfx_component_disable("NVIDIA" REASON "NVIDIA integration is (currently) only available for Windows under Direct3D11.")
endif()
